newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor prices rise, cylone may hurt crops.
newsitem.headline: India castor prices rise, cylone may hurt crops.

text.p: Indian castor prices gained after early falls on Friday on fears that a cylone that hit the southeast coast may delay crop arrivals, traders said.
"The cyclone (which hit Andhra Pradesh on Wednesday) may delay new crop arrivals and even lead to crop loss in some areas," one trader said.
Prices fell to 1,089/1,090 rupees from 1,094/1,095 rupees but later in the day rose to 1,093/1,094 rupees.
Groundnut oil rose to 362/363 rupees from 356/357 rupees on renewed physical buying. In Rajkot spot oil rose by five rupees to 540 rupees per 15 kg.
